issue_context.title: WebGPURenderer depth/stencil buffer duplication/confusion
issue_context.body:
### Description

When rendering to the screen in multiple passes, multiple depth buffers are created associated with the multiple render contexts created, combined with the use of current and last render contexts in the clear() call, this leads to unexpected results.

Is it a deliberate intention to have multiple depth buffers associated with the display buffer?

### Reproduction steps

With no render targets set and the following sequence in a render loop, the two clear calls do not have the expected effects.

1. renderer.clear();  // clears depth buffer B
2. renderer.render( sceneA, cameraA );  // render context (a) with depth buffer A
3. render.clearDepth();  // clears depth buffer A
4. renderer.render( sceneB, cameraB ); // render context (b) with depth buffer B
